summary: HUTCHMED (China) Limited filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, on September 24, 2026, disclosing that clinical data from its internally discovered compounds will be presented at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid on October 23-27. Two Phase III studies of the savolitinib plus osimertinib combination, SAFFRON and SANOVO, were selected for late-breaking oral presentations following positive high-level results reported August 17 and August 31, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved, so no deal terms are stated. This is a routine scientific disclosure, not a special situation; watch for any subsequent licensing or partnering implications.
